TEXT:
[FI] After taking a gander at Kinkaku-ji Temple, Manami 
and I made our way to the Studio Park.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Wow, there sure are a lot of people here.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] They're all tourists, like us. Oh, right...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Please wait for a bit. I'm going to change my 
clothes.

[FI] With that, she jogged over to a nearby building. I 
bet she's getting herself dressed in those feudal-era 
costumes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Watch your step~

[FI] After the brief reminder, I patiently awaited her 
return.
[FI] Several minutes later.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kyou-chan, sorry to make you wait.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, that was... nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] H-How do I look?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Why a Town Girl costume?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] I-Is it strange? I've been wanting to try this on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Nah, it's not strange at all. In fact, it really suits you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Really? Ehehe, I'm so happy.

[FI] Didn't expect the costume to fit her so well, in 
more ways than one... There's no underestimating 
her.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah, you're probably the most well-dressed out of 
everyone here.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Oh, you're just exaggerating... Ehehe, I got praised 
by Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I'm just being honest. This suits you way better 
than some princess cosplay.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Thank you, Kyou-chan. But, even if you say things 
like that, I can't give you anything in return...

[FI] She says that, but she's sticking her hand out to me. 
Probably wants the point card.
[FI] Can't give anything? What's this, then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, thanks.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Thank you for your patronage.①

[FI] While I might be interested in the rewards, the 
process of collecting points is fun in its own way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Seriously though... that really looks good on you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Ehehe.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Oh yeah! Since you're cosplaying like a town girl, 
maybe you could do "that"!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eh? What?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That thing the evil magistrates always do.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, you mean when they go "It's fine, isn't it?", then 
they spin the girls around by pulling the sash?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, that.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Hmm, I think I'd get pretty dizzy.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Wanna give it a go?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eh?  But, it's not very safe.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Um, Kyou-chan? Why do you look so disappointed?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm not... disappointed at all...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, you know, speaking of this cosplay, I think the 
old you will be better suited for it.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Eh?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I mean, you were really plain back then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I bet if that happens, you will blend into the 
background, no one would notice you at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Kyou-chan, you're so mean. Boo...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I told you not to act like that... Oh, never mind. Shall 
we have a look around?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Yup, let's go.
[FI] And with that, we went around the Studio Park.
